2026-10-07-modelling-pharmacy-claims-in-.title: Modelling Batch Pharmacy Claims in FHIR
2026-10-07-modelling-pharmacy-claims-in-.description: FHIR has no ClaimBatch resource, and NCPDP batch files don't care about REST. How we composed Task, List, Claim, ClaimResponse, ExplanationOfBenefit and PaymentReconciliation into a claims lifecycle with at-least-once delivery that's safe to retry.

2026-10-12-good-engineering-habits-age-b.title: Good Engineering Habits Age Better Than Technology: Rereading My Final-Year Project
2026-10-12-good-engineering-habits-age-b.description: Rereading my final-year project from the mid-1990s, I was struck by how little the core lessons have changed. The stack is obsolete, but the habits still look right: understand users, iterate, separate concerns, write things down, and design for change.
